answer.origin: Primary source: NVIDIA Corporation Form 8-K current report (SEC EDGAR, filed and dated August 17, 2026; Items 1.01, 2.03 and 7.01, with a press release as Exhibit 99.1). The statement is NVIDIA's own disclosure of an agreement it entered on August 17, 2026, so it is a fact-tier company statement rather than a secondary report.
answer.note: On August 17, 2026 NVIDIA disclosed that it entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy as Lessor, covering leases for about 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site (PORTS Technology Campus, Pike County, Ohio). An affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC is the tenant. NVIDIA also has an option, exercisable in its sole discretion, to provide credit support for about an additional 3.8 GW at the site. NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is capped at 105 billion dollars for the initial commitment. Payments are conditional on the Lessor meeting ready-for-service conditions, expected beginning in 2028. A payment is triggered by an OpenAI insolvency-driven lease default or an OpenAI payment failure, and generally equals the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and recoveries from re-leasing or sale. NVIDIA's obligations end at the earliest of the 20th anniversary of lease commencement, lease termination by OpenAI under its terms, OpenAI reaching a satisfactory credit rating, or other customary events. OpenAI agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts NVIDIA actually pays. The source says OpenAI will use the capacity to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform, subject to limited exceptions. Conditional interpretation: the 8-K establishes an undertaken, contingent guarantee exposure of up to 105 billion dollars for the initial commitment, not a booked payment. That exposure is linked to OpenAI credit performance and to the timing of the 2028 ready-for-service conditions, and it is partly offset by OpenAI's reimbursement undertaking, whose collectability the filing does not assess. The DSX deployment statement is a planned use of capacity, not disclosed orders, revenue or shipments, so it supports a demand and deployment-scale signal for NVIDIA's platform rather than a confirmed purchase amount. The 3.8 GW expansion is discretionary and carries no disclosed commitment.
limitations: The full text of the Agreements is not available in the source; the 8-K states the form will be filed as an exhibit to the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, so lease terms, guaranteed minimum values, cap mechanics and reimbursement terms are known only from the summary.
The source does not state when each lease commences, so the timing and effectiveness of each Agreement beyond the 'expected beginning in 2028' ready-for-service statement are unknown.
The ready-for-service timing is an expectation stated in a forward-looking statement, not a confirmed date.
The filing does not disclose the accounting treatment, expected fair value, reserve or balance sheet impact of the guaranties, so the economic size of the expected payment is unknown.
The filing does not assess OpenAI's credit standing or the ability of the OpenAI affiliate to meet its reimbursement and lease obligations, so the net exposure after reimbursement is unknown.
The source does not disclose the economics, pricing or volume of NVIDIA DSX platform sales tied to the Portsmouth deployment, so no NVIDIA revenue or order amount can be inferred from it.
The source does not state the terms, conditions or timing for exercising the discretionary credit support covering about 3.8 GW beyond the 4.25 GW initial commitment.
The source is a single company disclosure with no independent confirmation in the supplied records; no historical comparison records were supplied.
follow_up: Review the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 when filed, for the full Agreements text, including guaranteed minimum value formulas, the 105 billion dollar cap, reimbursement and indemnity terms, and termination provisions.
Check the 10-Q and subsequent filings for any accounting disclosure of the residual value guaranties, including recognized liabilities, fair value and contingent loss disclosures.
Track SB Energy and OpenAI public disclosures for lease commencement dates, ready-for-service milestones at the Portsmouth Site and any changes to tenant arrangements.
Check NVIDIA's next annual and quarterly filings for any disclosed revenue, backlog or order amounts linked to the DSX AI factory deployment at the site.
